parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Court-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 16.8 | 2.56 | 2.56
2 | 73.3 | 10.4 | 12.9
3 | 701 | 49.9 | 62.9
4 | 51.6 | 51.4 | 114
5 | 99.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Court-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AKH
Aquifer depth: 62.9 – 114 m (Layer 4, 51.6 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target the moderate-resistivity sand/sandy-clay unit between 62.9 m and 114 m as the main water-bearing zone; case off the overlying highly resistive layer (12.9–62.9 m) to prevent borehole collapse and cross-contamination, and confirm aquifer continuity with drill cuttings during advancement.
